title: Arabic landing page in an RTL document
request: أنشئ صفحة هبوط لمنصة حجز مواعيد للعيادات: قسم رئيسي يشرح الفكرة، ثلاث مزايا، آراء عملاء، ودعوة للتسجيل.
rubric: Is the copy actually in Arabic and idiomatic — not English content with an Arabic heading bolted on — and does it suit a clinic booking product?
why: The document direction is rtl, so this case fails loudly for any planner that only ever writes English or that tries to solve direction with a CSS override instead of the document dir.
